pages.text: A workbench for studying weapons.$(br2)$(li)$(k:use) with a weapon to set it on the bench.$(li)$(k:use) with an empty hand to examine it.$(li)$(k:sneak) + $(k:use) to take it back.
Examining a weapon shows everything BHB knows about it: its type, whether it's two-handed, each attack variant's chance, speed and damage, and when its hit lands, plus its Overpower ratings.
